verdict.rationale: Linear ships a first-party Linear Agent. Users can delegate issues to it, and it writes code via Claude Code/Codex in cloud sessions, then sets up, runs, and browser-tests its work. Delegated issues and session status appear under My Issues, and users can invoke it with "@Linear can you take a stab at this?" It also drafts updates ("Write with Agent"), edits text, investigates new issues, and runs recurring Loops on schedules or events. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent's delegated work holds up in practice, since all evidence is vendor changelog/marketing.
